summary_error.description: Exception type name logged when _run_summary encountered a read error; present only on degraded entries.

run_event.description: A single orchestration event. additionalProperties mirrors the raw file; any key whose name matches a credential pattern (api_key, password, secret, api_token, auth_token, credential) is replaced with "[REDACTED]" at every depth by the server before the event is included in a response.

total.description: Number of valid run directories found during the scan. When total_scan_truncated is true the scan was capped at _RUNS_SCAN_LIMIT (500) entries, so this is a lower bound on the actual number of run directories.

total_scan_truncated.description: true when the runs directory has more than _RUNS_SCAN_LIMIT (500) entries; total is then a lower bound on the actual number of valid run dirs

oversized_seqs.description: Seq numbers of events omitted because a single event exceeded the byte budget (_RUNS_EVENTS_BYTE_BUDGET). The client may use these to know which seqs were skipped.

receipt_response.description: Receipt and verification for a completed run. additionalProperties mirrors the raw receipt file; any key whose name matches a credential pattern (api_key, password, secret, api_token, auth_token, credential) is replaced with "[REDACTED]" at every depth by the server before being served. Digest verification runs on the raw file bytes before redaction so the verify result is correct.
